英文原文: "Oh, no, just a little surprised is all."
中文译文: "不不，我们只是有点惊讶。"

英文原文: "Yes, we were told the springs would be private for the day."
中文译文: "的确，我们被告知今天的温泉不对外开放。"

英文原文: I want to tell Amicus to be a little more polite considering this man is one of the triumvirs of Lux, and he'll be traveling with us for the rest of the mission.
中文译文: 考虑到对方是卢克斯的三人执政团之一，且将在接下来的任务中与我们同行，我很想劝Amicus礼貌一点。

英文原文: I also understand why Amicus is as agitated as he is.
中文译文: 我能理解Amicus为何如此激动。

英文原文: Interrupted in the middle of a very private moment by the man who humiliated him yesterday.
中文译文: 私密时刻被昨天让自己出丑的人搅和了。

英文原文: "Of course. I'll be taking my leave soon enough. I just wanted to make sure that the accommodations are to your liking."
中文译文: "没有错，我只是来确认这里的招待是否符合您的喜好，不会久留的。"

英文原文: He indicates the buckets, towels, and drinks.
中文译文: 他指了指桶，毛巾和酒。

英文原文: "That and I thought I might take the opportunity to get to know the head of the delegation and his companion a bit better."
中文译文: "而且，我想我可以借此机会 ，更好地了解一下代表团领袖和他的伴侣。"

英文原文: Amicus takes a deep breath, possibly to make it more clear to the other wolf that he's not interested in doing that at the moment.
中文译文: Amicus长叹一口气，可能是想让另一只狼明白，眼下他没有这个兴趣。

英文原文: I finally speak up to hopefully distract Magis from Amicus's rudeness.
中文译文: 无奈之下我开口了，希望把Magis的注意力从Amicus的粗鲁中转移开。

英文原文: "Yeah, it's great. Thank you, Magis."
中文译文: "啊，招待很周到，谢谢你的关心，Magis。"

英文原文: "Of course, [mc]. I was not aware of your favorite drink, so I settled on {i}virdi{/i} since I understand not everyone enjoys their alcohol."
中文译文: "您客气了，[mc]。我知道不是所有人都喜欢喝酒，于是带了{b}virdi{/b}来，如果合您口味的话就再好不过了。"

英文原文: "That's perfect, actually, thanks again."
中文译文: "太棒了，请容我再次表达感谢。"

英文原文: "Yes, the drinks are fantastic. It was good to speak to you today, Magis, but my companion and I were discussing some private matters--"
中文译文: "是的，饮料很棒，很高兴跟你谈话，Magis，但我和我的伴侣正在讨论一些私事..."

英文原文: "Oh, of course, I'll be on my way, but I did want to ask--"
中文译文: "噢，没问题，我这就告辞。不过在此之前-"

英文原文: "Are you quite alright after our bout yesterday? I know you assured us of your wellness, but after reflecting on it overnight, I wanted to make sure."
中文译文: "昨天比赛过后，您的身体还好吗？我知道您向我们保证过，但经过一夜的思考，我想亲自确认一下。"

英文原文: Amicus stares straight ahead, into the distance, as if not acknowledging that Magis is touching him will allow him to pretend it's not happening.
中文译文: Amicus直直盯着远方，仿佛只要不承认Magis的接触，就可以当什么都没发生过一样。

英文原文: "As I said yesterday, I am perfectly fine. Thank you."
中文译文: "正如我昨天说的，我很好，谢谢。"

英文原文: "Yes, I only ask again due to the fact that I understand the issue of optics when it comes to being a high-ranked official, especially while you are in Lux."
中文译文: "嗯，我之所以这么问，是因为我理解身居高位的烦恼，尤其是在卢克斯这样的环境下。"

英文原文: This seems to finally break Amicus's dwindling patience.
中文译文: Amicus的耐心似乎消磨殆尽了。

英文原文: "You forget yourself, Magis. The position of triumvirate is quite different from that of emperor. I say what I mean."
中文译文: "少得意忘形了，Magis，皇帝是你们三人执政团也难望其背的存在。我说没事就是没事。"

英文原文: I feel a sinking feeling in my chest as Amicus drops all attempts at appearing proper.
中文译文: Amicus彻底丢掉了体面，我只感觉胸口一沉。

英文原文: I completely understand Amicus's frustration right now, but Magis's sincere tone is, as far as I can tell, completely genuine.
中文译文: 我完全理解Amicus的沮丧，但就目前而言，Magis的关心确实是真心实意的。

英文原文: I realize then that I need to alleviate the situation somehow.
中文译文: 我得想办法缓解现在的状况。

英文原文: "Amicus, YOU are forgetting yourself."
中文译文: "得意忘形的是{b}你{/b}吧，Amicus。"

英文原文: I adopt a more chiding tone, wanting to keep the feel of the situation more lighthearted.
中文译文: 我用了比平时更严厉的语气，想恢复轻松的气氛。

英文原文: "Please excuse our emperor. We were up very late last night."
中文译文: "请见谅，我们昨天睡得很晚。"

英文原文: I feel that's the best explanation I can make up.
中文译文: 这是我能给出的最合理的解释了。

英文原文: It's a childish one, but that's the point.
中文译文: 很幼稚，但我要的就是这个效果。

英文原文: While I am Amicus's companion, and far more than that, I still need to take care not to forget {i}my{/i} self."
中文译文: 我是Amicus的伴侣，且远不止于此，但我仍需牢记{b}自己{/b}的分寸。"

英文原文: I need to keep Amicus looking good, even while criticizing him.
中文译文: 即便是在批评Amicus的时候，我也要保持他的良好形象。

英文原文: And I can do that by making myself seem frivolous, stupid, even.
中文译文: 我可以通过让自己显得轻浮，甚至愚蠢来做到这一点。

英文原文: Mainly, I just need to give Magis an excuse to be distracted from Amicus's slip in professionalism.
中文译文: 更重要的是，我需要给Magis一个台阶，让他不去在意Amicus的失态。

英文原文: I feel like I did a mostly good job considering Amicus just continues to stare out at a place somewhere to my left and over my head.
中文译文: 鉴于Amicus一直盯着我左边的某个地方

英文原文: "Ah, I see. I do apologize for imposing myself upon you. I shouldn't have taken advantage of the situation in such a way."
中文译文: "啊，原来如此。很抱歉，我不该利用二位出游这个机会。"

英文原文: Again, his sincerity is striking, and that's unusual.
中文译文: 他言语里的真诚非比寻常。

英文原文: Maybe that's why Amicus is so cold:
中文译文: 也许这就是Amicus如此冷漠的原因了。

英文原文: He doesn't fully trust this wolf.
中文译文: 他不完全相信这只狼。

英文原文: "You didn't take advantage of the situation. It's just an inconvenient time, unfortunately."
中文译文: "你言过了，只是时间不凑巧而已。"

英文原文: I glance at Amicus before continuing.
中文译文: 我瞥了Amicus一眼，才继续说道：

英文原文: "Why don't we meet later for lunch, or dinner?"
中文译文: "我们何不午餐或晚餐的时候再见呢？"

英文原文: There's a pause, as if we're both waiting for a confirmation from Amicus.
中文译文: 对话停了一会儿，好像我们都在等待Amicus的确认。

英文原文: "How about dinner?"
中文译文: "晚餐如何？"

英文原文: Seeming to decide that my word is good enough, the triumvir agrees.
中文译文: 他似乎认可了我的话。

英文原文: "I would be honored."
中文译文: "我很荣幸。"

英文原文: Magis rises out of his spring, water splashing off of his fur.
中文译文: Magis从温泉中起身，溅起洋洋洒洒的水花。

英文原文: Usually, when a furred creature gets wet, their overall stature becomes less impressive.
中文译文: 通常，当一个长毛的生物被淋湿时，它的整体身材就会变得比较不忍直视。

英文原文: Cassius and Alex come to mind.
中文译文: 我脑中浮现出了Cassius和Alex。

英文原文: But for Amicus, and for Magis, it turns out, the opposite is true, and I can see why his kicks had been so powerful.
中文译文: 然而对Amicus和Magis来说，事实恰恰相反，我想我能理解他的踢腿为何如此强劲了。

英文原文: Amicus glances at him, then at me, so I quickly avert my gaze.
中文译文: Amicus看了看他，又望向我，我迅速转移了视线。

英文原文: I don't want to give Amicus any more reason to feel inadequate, even if it's not a good reason.
中文译文: 我不想让Amicus感觉自己不称职，就算这是他的错。

英文原文: "I'll meet you at your villa, if that's alright? Thirteenth hour?"
中文译文: "我会在第十三时造访二位的庄园，这样可以吗？"

英文原文: When there's no input from Amicus, I agree.
中文译文: Amicus没有表示，于是我同意了。

英文原文: "That sounds good."
中文译文: "听起来不错。"

英文原文: "Alright, I will see you then. Have a nice soak, Your Highness."
中文译文: "好的，那我们到时候见。祝您过得愉快，陛下。"

英文原文: With that, Magis disappears around the trail, I assume to where his own towel is stashed.
中文译文: 说罢，Magis消失在了小径上，我猜是去了放毛巾的地方。

英文原文: It's silent for a few moments, then I sigh.
中文译文: 又过了一会儿，我叹了口气，打破了沉默。

英文原文: "Amicus, that was terrible."
中文译文: "你的态度太差了，Amicus。"

英文原文: "I know."
中文译文: "我知道。"

英文原文: He's grumpy now, so I know we aren't going to pick up where we left off.
中文译文: 他在生气，看来按摩的事要泡汤了。

英文原文: "Well, at least you can try to salvage something over dinner."
中文译文: "唉，起码你能在晚餐的时候挽回一下。"

英文原文: "Yeah."
It's quiet for a bit, then Amicus huffs.
中文译文: 沉默了一段时间后，Amicus气呼呼地开了口。

英文原文: "Thank you, [mc]. I was not handling that well."
中文译文: "谢谢你，[mc]，是我欠妥了。"

英文原文: "Happens to the best of us, but I think you should at least give the guy a chance."
中文译文: "人非圣贤，孰能无过，但你至少该给他个机会。"

英文原文: "Maybe. I just need more time after yesterday."
中文译文: "也许吧，只是我也有我的顾虑。"

英文原文: "Of course."
中文译文: "看得出来。"

英文原文: While the mood is ruined, I tell myself that it could have been worse.
中文译文: 虽然好心情被毁了，但我知道，这可能还不是最糟的。

英文原文: When we return to the villa, I can immediately tell that something's wrong.
中文译文: 等回到庄园，我立马就觉察哪里不对劲。

英文原文: Bjarni is there, looking more upset than I've ever seen him.
中文译文: Bjarni一反常态，露出了沮丧的表情。

英文原文: That's not saying much, but considering he almost always defaults to a professional, cheerful demeanor, it's obvious that something is very wrong.
中文译文: 其实这也没什么，但考虑到他总是给人以专业的、积极乐观的形象，很明显出大事了。

英文原文: I think I have a good idea of what it might be, and as soon as Bjarni starts talking, I'm proved right.
中文译文: Bjarni证实了我的猜想。

英文原文: "Your Highness, it seems that the situation in the city has become tense after the issue with the Khemians."
中文译文: "陛下，在与克米扬发生冲突后，该地的局势骤然紧张了起来。"

英文原文: "Of course it has."
中文译文: "不出所料。"

英文原文: "There are rumors that a concerted protest is being planned around the twelfth hour."
中文译文: "根据传言，他们准备在第十二时前后发动一场联合抗议。"

英文原文: "What is the actual issue? Do they simply want the Khemians gone, or--"
中文译文: "他们的真实诉求是什么？驱逐克米扬，还是-"

英文原文: "The issue has become broader since then. While the initial complaints centered around the Khemians supposedly turning their noses up at Luxian culture--"
中文译文: "最初，人们的抱怨集中在据称对卢克斯文化不屑一顾的克米扬身上，但经过发酵-"

英文原文: "Of course."
中文译文: "我就知道。"

英文原文: "Now it is more about why you, the emperor, would bring them along."
中文译文: "他们把矛头转向了将他们带来的陛下您。"

英文原文: "Of course."
中文译文: "果不其然。"

英文原文: It's quiet for a moment.
中文译文: 在场没有一个人说话。

英文原文: "Is there something we can do to appease them?"
中文译文: "我们能做些什么来安抚他们吗？"

英文原文: Bjarni looks over at me, then sighs as he puts away his portal.
中文译文: Bjarni看了过来，接着叹了口气，放下终端。

英文原文: "It's difficult to say. Once Luxians set their minds on something, especially something that makes them upset, it's hard to dissuade them."
中文译文: "很难，卢克斯人可谓是不撞南墙不死心的类型，尤其是在让他们不爽的事情上。"

英文原文: "What if Neferu, or Brunis apologize? Not that they should apologize for anything, but maybe that'll be enough to calm the people?"
中文译文: "那让Neferu或Brunis道歉呢？并不是说他们应该道歉，但也许能缓解局势？"

英文原文: "No, that will only make them more upset. Khemians come off as condescending whenever they're apologizing."
中文译文: "不，这只会进一步激怒人群，克米扬在道歉时总是喜欢摆出高人一等的架势。"

英文原文: I know that's likely only due to the wolves inferiority complex, but I don't say it out loud, of course.
中文译文: 依我看，这多半只是因为沃尔文的自卑情结，但我当然不会傻到大声说出来。

英文原文: "Are Neferu and Brunis here?"
中文译文: "Neferu和Brunis在吗？"

英文原文: I look around and notice that the door to the spare bedroom is still closed.
中文译文: 我环顾四周，发现备用卧室的门依然紧闭着。

英文原文: "Er, yes, though Brunis wanted a private moment with Neferu."
中文译文: "呃，是的，不过Brunis想跟Neferu私下谈谈。"

英文原文: I look at the closed door, feeling incredibly sorry for the jackal at the moment.
中文译文: 我凝视着那扇门，为胡狼感到无比抱歉。

英文原文: I wonder if Neferu will even be up for the trip to Lupas tomorrow.
中文译文: 这下Neferu能否参与明天的鲁帕斯之行也是个未知数了。

英文原文: That will be even more difficult for the two of us, though in a different way.
中文译文: 尽管处境不同，但我们都将面临重重困难。

英文原文: "I regret to say it, but it might be best to simply leave within a few hours."
中文译文: "很遗憾，我们最好在几个小时内撤离。"

英文原文: My heart sinks into my stomach at hearing that.
中文译文: 听到这话，我的心沉了下去。

英文原文: Amicus seems to have the same feeling.
中文译文: Amicus也一样。

英文原文: "No, I cannot leave this city worse than it was when I arrived. That will mean absolute failure on Adastra's part. I must... make a speech, or something."
中文译文: "不，我不能就这样离开，这意味着阿达斯特拉彻底的失败。我必须...召开个演讲之类的。"

英文原文: "I agree, but I'm not sure what else can be done. The longer we stay, the more time the city has to fester in its anger."
中文译文: "我同意，但这也是无奈之举。我们待得越久，这座城市的怒火就燃得越旺。"

英文原文: "But I must."
中文译文: "我意已决。"

英文原文: Based on my teachings, I know that more than a few emperors have lost their lives in this city.
中文译文: 根据我学到的知识，在此地丧生的皇帝绝不在少数。

英文原文: While the last time was at least a few thousand years ago, they city hasn't changed all that much since and I feel a great deal of worry for my wolf.
中文译文: 虽然上一次已经是千年前了，但自那以后，这座城市也没有多大的变化。我不禁为我的狼捏了一把汗。

英文原文: "He's right, Amicus. If this city can get as bad as you say, it would be too dangerous for you to try and calm them."
中文译文: "他说的有道理，Amicus。如果这座城真像你描述的那么糟糕，那安抚他们就太危险了。"

英文原文: I also worry that his skill in rhetoric isn't good enough for this situation.
中文译文: 我同样担心他的修辞水平不足以应付这种情况。

英文原文: He's good, but not as good as--
中文译文: 他讲得是很棒，但不如-

英文原文: "Amicus, what the hell!?"
中文译文: "究竟是怎么回事，Amicus！？"

英文原文: "I'm absent for less than a single day and the city is ready for a riot!"
中文译文: "我才出去不到一天，整座城市都要翻天了！"

英文原文: He barged in without any of us hearing it.
中文译文: 谁也没有听见他进来。

英文原文: "Cass, now is NOT the time."
中文译文: "现在{b}不是{/b}时候，Cass。"

英文原文: "Now IS the time! Amicus, Lux will tear itself apart over this!"
中文译文: "现在{b}正是{/b}时候，Amicus！再这样下去，卢克斯会分裂的！"

英文原文: "What? Over perceived insults from the Khemians that likely didn't happen in the first place?"
中文译文: "什么？就因为受到-从一开始就不存在的-克米扬的蔑视？"

英文原文: "No, Amicus, over {i}rumors{/i}. What actually happened doesn't matter. What does matter is that now they are saying Neferu spat on the food offered to him."
中文译文: "不，Amicus，因为{b}谣言{/b}。实际发生了什么并不重要，重要的是，他们称Neferu向提供给他的食物吐了口水。"

英文原文: "Gods..."
Amicus takes a deep breath.
中文译文: Amicus深深吸了一口气。

英文原文: "Well, I suppose I should prepare myself to give some sort of speech--"
中文译文: "好吧，看来我应该准备演讲-"

英文原文: "A--Are you serious, Amicus?"
中文译文: "你-你没在开玩笑吧，Amicus？"

英文原文: "Of course."
中文译文: "当然没有。"

英文原文: "You idiot."
中文译文: "白痴。"

英文原文: "Shut the hell up, Cass, you don't understand--"
中文译文: "闭上你的嘴，Cass，你不了解-"

英文原文: "I understand far more about this city than you ever will!"
中文译文: "我比你们任何人都更了解这座城市！"

英文原文: Cassius's screeching voice reverberates around the villa in the most grating way possible and I see Amicus lower his ears in response.
中文译文: Cassius尖锐的声音以最刺耳的方式回荡在庄园中，我看到Amicus垂下了耳朵。

英文原文: Now Cassius takes a deep breath.
中文译文: 现在轮到Cassius深吸气了。

英文原文: "They will kill you if you set foot in the amphitheater alone."
中文译文: "你敢只身踏进竞技场，他们就敢杀了你。"

英文原文: "There are drones that will protect him."
中文译文: "无人机可以保护他。"

英文原文: Bjarni chimes in from the sidelines in his usual, cheerful way.
中文译文: Bjarni愉快地插话道，和平时一样。

英文原文: "Oh yes, and that will lead to such a rebellion that the city will once again declare itself an independent city-state. Good luck trying to repair at any point during your rule, Amicus."
中文译文: "没错，而这将导致一场叛乱，卢克斯将再次宣布自己是一个独立的城邦。祝你在统治期间好运，Amicus。"

英文原文: Amicus finally seems to relent.
中文译文: Amicus终于松口了。

英文原文: "Alright, then do you have anything to propose yourself, Cassius?"
中文译文: "好吧，那你有什么建议吗，Cassius？"

英文原文: Cassius goes quiet for a few moments, seeming to gather his thoughts.
中文译文: Cassius沉默了片刻，像是在聚精会神地思考。

英文原文: I can tell what he says next takes a good deal of effort on his part.
中文译文: 我看得出他下了很大的决心。

英文原文: Then he sags a bit.
中文译文: 接着他颓了颓肩。

英文原文: "I suppose you could say that my performance yesterday was not adequate.
中文译文: "昨天是我发挥失误了。"

英文原文: He pauses, as if waiting for Amicus to say something, though the other wolf remains quiet.
中文译文: 他顿了一下，好像在等待Amicus说些什么，尽管另一只狼保持了沉默。

英文原文: "Therefore you might say that at least a small part of this is my fault."
中文译文: "酿成如今这个局面，也有一小部分错在我。"

英文原文: Another pause, but Amicus just waits.
中文译文: 他又是一顿，但Amicus还是沉默不语。

英文原文: "A very small part, but a part nonetheless. Therefore, I shall give another speech."
中文译文: "很小一部分错，但我毕竟难辞其咎。因此，我要再发表一篇演讲。"

英文原文: Finally, Amicus shows some surprise at what Cassius just said.
中文译文: Amicus终于对Cassius说的话表示出了惊讶。

英文原文: "And the people shall be allowed to actually attend the speech. None of this curfew nonsense. This is part of the reason they are so upset."
中文译文: "并且人民应该被允许参与进来。别搞什么宵禁，这也是他们如此不安分的一部分原因。"

英文原文: "Are you sure? I don't think I could let you--"
中文译文: "你确定吗？我不能让你-"

英文原文: "Oh, stop it, Amicus. I know what I'm doing."
中文译文: "哦，得了吧，Amicus，我知道自己在做什么。"

英文原文: "Do you?"
中文译文: "真的？"

英文原文: "I've given speeches in Lux at least half-a-dozen times, so yes, I do."
中文译文: "我在卢克斯至少演讲过六次，所以是的。"

英文原文: Amicus eyes Cassius carefully, as if unsure of the other wolf's intentions.
中文译文: Amicus仔细打量着Cassius，似乎拿不准另一只狼的意图。

英文原文: "Keep in mind that if I want this mission to succeed anywhere, it is here in Lux. I would not be able to bring myself to leave this city the way it is now."
中文译文: "我无法弃这座城市于不顾。听好，如果现在逃了，那再去其他城市也只会是白费功夫。"

英文原文: "I would at least like them to have a little hope for the future, as that is all we can offer them at the moment."
中文译文: "祈祷他们对未来还抱有一丝希望吧，这是我们目前能提供的全部了。"

英文原文: "Maybe we could mention that infrastructure project we were talking about last night, Amicus?"
中文译文: "也许可以讲一下咱俩昨晚说过的有关基础设施的计划，Amicus?"

英文原文: "Er, possibly. It might be a bit early for that, though."
中文译文: "呃，现在可能还不是时候。"

英文原文: "What are you on about?"
中文译文: "你们在说什么呢？"

英文原文: "Well, we discussed tentative plans to better connect Lux to Adastra City, possibly by use of Khemian tech, but I don't think--"
中文译文: "我们就如何完善卢克斯与阿达斯特拉城之间的交通进行了初步讨论，或许会用到克希米亚的技术，但我不确定..."

英文原文: Cassius seems to be thinking deeply, much to my surprise.
中文译文: Cassius似乎陷入了沉思，这让我颇感意外。

英文原文: "Actually, that does give me an idea. Where's the jackal?"
中文译文: "我受到了启发，胡狼在哪？"

英文原文: "Here in the villa. Why?"
中文译文: "在庄园里，怎么了？"

英文原文: "Summon him. I have an idea, but it involves bringing him, and you along."
中文译文: "传他过来。我想到一个主意，但需要他的配合，还有你的。"

英文原文: Cassius looks directly at me.
中文译文: Cassius直视着我。

英文原文: To be continued...
中文译文: 未完待续...
